name_zh: 莫里斯·张/台积电创始团队：半导体生态链主与科技儒商共生
name_en: Morris Chang/TSMC Founding Team: Semiconductor Ecosystem Chain-Master & Tech-Confucian Merchant Symbiosis
description_zh: 张忠谋 (1931-) 1987 年创立台积电 (TSMC)，开创"纯晶圆代工"模式，打破 IDM 垂直整合垄断，构建全球半导体产业新生态：设计公司(联发科/恩智浦/高通)专注设计，台积电专注制造，ASML/应用材料供设备，ARM/IP 提供架构。核心机制：开放创新平台 (OIP) + 可信代工承诺 + 先进制程技术领先 (3nm/2nm) + 客户共创生态。张忠谋以"科技儒商"身份跨越中美台三地，将儒家"诚信立业、师徒传承、家族治理"注入硅谷管理范式，体现 M160 台湾科技儒商共生模式——技术官僚理性+儒商长期主义+生态位主导。
description_en: Morris Chang (1931-) founded TSMC in 1987, pioneering "pure-play foundry" model, breaking IDM vertical integration monopoly, constructing new global semiconductor ecosystem: design houses (MediaTek/NXP/Qualcomm) focus design, TSMC focuses manufacturing, ASML/Applied Materials supply equipment, ARM/IP provide architecture. Core mechanism: Open Innovation Platform (OIP) + trusted foundry commitment + advanced node leadership (3nm/2nm) + customer co-creation ecosystem. Chang as "tech-Confucian merchant" spanning US-China-Taiwan, infused Confucian "integrity in business, master-apprentice transmission, family governance" into Silicon Valley management paradigm, exemplifying M160 Taiwan Tech-Confucian Merchant Symbiosis—technocratic rationality + Confucian long-termism + ecosystem dominance.
reason_zh: 台积电非单一企业，而是半导体产业的"操作系统"：掌握先进制程话语权，定义产业标准，分配产能红利。M160 独特区隔于 M153 儒商百年传承(家族)、M158 通才整合(个人)，核心在于"平台生态+国家战略+儒商伦理"三位一体。
reason_en: TSMC is not a single firm but semiconductor industry's "operating system": controls advanced node discourse, defines industry standards, allocates capacity dividends. M160 uniquely distinct from M153 Confucian Merchant Legacy (family) and M158 Polymath Integration (individual), core: trinity of "platform ecosystem + national strategy + Confucian merchant ethics".
steps_zh: 模式创新与信任锚定：1987年纯代工模式，拒绝竞争客户设计，建立"可信中立"品牌承诺
开放创新平台构建：OIP/PDK/IP 联盟，降低客户设计门槛，锁定产业链上游
技术领先持续投入：研发占营收 8-10%，3nm/2nm/GAA 持续领先 1-2 代
生态位主导与标准制定：Advanced/Intel/AMD/Apple 绑定，台积电产能=全球芯片供给上限
儒商治理传承：张忠谋退休后魏哲家/蒋尚义接班，家族/师徒/校友网络治理，长期主义文化固化
steps_en: Model innovation & trust anchoring: 1987 pure foundry model, refuses competing with customer designs, establishes "trusted neutral" brand promise
Open Innovation Platform construction: OIP/PDK/IP alliance, lowers customer design barrier, locks upstream supply chain
Sustained tech leadership investment: R&D 8-10% revenue, 3nm/2nm/GAA persistent 1-2 gen lead
Ecosystem dominance & standard setting: Advanced/Intel/AMD/Apple bound, TSMC capacity = global chip supply ceiling
Confucian merchant governance transmission: Chang retirement -> C.C. Wei/S.C. Chiang succession, family/master-apprentice/alumni network governance, long-termist culture solidified
expected_zh: 小岛经济体以"单一关键技术+平台生态+儒商治理"锁定全球产业命脉，实现技术主权与商业主权双赢。
expected_en: Small island economy locks global industrial lifeline via "single critical tech + platform ecosystem + Confucian governance", achieving tech sovereignty & commercial sovereignty dual win.
case_zh: 2023年台积电营收 2.16 兆新台币，市值全球前十，先进制程(7nm 以下) 市占率 >90%，全球 90%+ AI 芯片/手机芯片/高性能计算芯片产自台积电。
case_en: 2023 TSMC revenue NT$2.16T, market cap global top 10, advanced node (<7nm) share >90%, 90%+ global AI/mobile/HPC chips from TSMC.
intellectual_tradition: Taiwan Tech-Confucian Merchant / Pure-Play Foundry Model
cross_cultural_impact: Global semiconductor supply chain reshaping; pure-play foundry model replication (GlobalFoundries/SMIC); tech sovereignty discourse
diaspora_influence: Silicon Valley Taiwanese diaspora core; US-Taiwan tech alliance anchor
